notes.title: WINTER SALE! Discounts for YOU!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41898333/83839842a854b3e89ecb06c25d02394ee3f69403.png[/img]


Feel free to change your wallpaper to something interesting. This is the best time to download my unique designs at such a low price.


[h1]Hello everyone and we wish you a Happy Holidays and an awesome 2024.[/h1]

My name is Greg and I am the founder of 3DM whose goal was to design and release unique designs as wallpapers on the Steam platform...and we did it. :D

3DM is not a company with offices and a team. 3DM has never had external financial support. I created 3DM as a single person who used my own funds to employ freelancers who coded my crazy ideas for you. I thank them very much for their support.

Despite everything, we managed to publish 14 projects that appeared on many screens around the world. Countless problems, sleepless nights, sweat and tears. Over time, we got better and the designs were improved thanks to the support of players. Thanks to your support. Thank you with all my heart.

As a thank you and on the occasion of the Winter Steam Sale, we are publishing big discounts for those who have just discovered my designs. I highly encourage you to try it and to support the micro developer.

[h3]I wish you a lot of health and joy with your loved ones.[/h3]

[h3]I wish 2024 to be better for everyone![/h3]

[h3]Big love and thanks for support. <brofist>[/h3]

[b]Best wishes,[/b]
Greg 3DM

notes.title: FULL VERSION
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

The Desktop Mars is finally ready to leave the Early Access stage.

The game has been improved and upgraded with new buildings to create more amazing Mars colonies.

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

Optimization to reduce PC usage.

Many new buildings.

The new mining drone system.

Improved menu.

Fixed minor bugs.

The new DUST STORMS system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41898333/13f647d98da7185ac4debd258f3e83478ab21e8a.jpg[/img]

[h2]One of the biggest problems on Mars is the dust. We had to add this part to the game.[/h2]

The dust in game will reduce the productivity of the dirty building. You will have to clean the building to keep productivity at a high level. The cleaning is on a single button. You don't have to click and click on the dirty building.

The new DUST STORM can also fully destroy some of the buildings.  


----------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]I would like to thank everyone for their support, interesting ideas and constructive feedback. Thanks to you, this game is much better. Thank you![/h2]

Please let me know with any problems. I will fix it ASAP! :D

[h2]Best Regards,[/h2]
3DM Greg

notes.title: DESKTOP MARS ENTERS EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone[/h1]

We are pleased, after many months of hard work, to present you a new DESKTOP MARS game displayed as a Windows10 / 11 wallpaper.

[b]Are you bored with normal wallpapers? Change it to the interactive game DESKTOP MARS where your goal will be to expand the base and increase the population of your colony.[/b]

We hope you will like building a colony on Mars in the style of Minecraft / Voxel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41898333/fec673b98eb4c166e14672789bccb1f6f1698456.jpg[/img]

[b]DESKTOP MARS is in the Early Access phase but is fully playable.[/b]
I am still working on this game, so there will be more content soon.

I am also working on the balance of the game and what it costs and what it gives. Probably these values ​​will change soon.

At the exit of Early Access, I plan to add something special that will change the gameplay a bit. We are working on it right now.

The game will also have more languages. Write what language you want.

If you experience any problems please report them in the "Discussions" panel on Steam. You can also feel free to write to me. I will write back as soon as possible.

[h2]Remember! This game requires WINDOWS 10/11 with all visual settings turned on. Read the "Discussion" panel for more information.[/h2]

[h1]Enjoy! : D[/h1]

[h2]All ideas and comments are welcome. ;)[/h2]

[b]Best Regards,[/b]
3DM Greg

notes.title: The new Trailer & Screenshots
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41898333/59bbc33b2adef7c9d4ed4631ddb9c582a4accae1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

We are finishing work on our new game DESKTOP MARS where you will be able to create your own Mars base on your Windows wallpaper.

We decided to slightly improve the graphics as the game itself is well optimized. The new quality required new screenshots which we replaced.

We have created a short video trailer to present the gameplay pieces of the new game. We hope you like it. A new, longer trailer will appear soon.

DESKTOP MARS is close to completion, so we encourage you to add the game to WISHLIST to be on time when the game is released on the Steam store.

We also encourage you to visit our Facebook and Twitter to follow the news.
